Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. Atul Bhatt, learned counsel for the
respondent-contemnor.
3. This contempt petition has been filed by the
petitioner alleging the non-compliance of the
order dated 16.10.2025 passed by the Writ Court
in WPMS No. 2881 of 2025, Abhay Sharma vs.
Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI),
whereby petitioner was given liberty to file
representation within two weeks and the
respondent-contemnor was directed to decide the
representation within six months thereafter.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the
respondent-contemnor supplied instructions
dated 22.09.2026 to this Court, which are taken
on record. On instructions, he submits that the
representation of the petitioner has been rejected
by the Competent Authority, i.e., Deputy
Director, Regional Office, Delhi, UIDAI.
5. Since compliance of the order has been
made and the representation has been rejected,
this contempt petition does not survive and the

UKHC010135102026
2026:UHC:8602
same is accordingly closed.
6. However, learned counsel for the
respondent-contemnor is directed to supply copy
of the rejection order of the representation today
itself to the learned counsel for the petitioner, so
that he may avail the legal remedy as per law.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
23.09.2026 AK
